June 2016 HCP Compliance Webinar

OSHA Program Updates

By now you've probably heard that the new HazCom standard has been revised to align with the Globally Harmonized System, or GHS. If we just caught you 100% unaware, or if you have been wondering just exactly what it means for your organization, or maybe you've wondered about a few of the details, this webinar is for you.

This month, we'll train you on the aspects of a strong OSHA compliance program. Discussion topics will include:

  • Hazard Communication Program Changes,
  • OSHA Biomedical Hazard Program information,
  • OSHA Hazard Risk Assessment requirements,
  • Safety Data Sheet E-binder,
  • OSHA Self Inspection and
  • Additional OSHA resources.
